description: A decision record with input summary, chosen arm, selection probability, policy version and outcome
A decision record without selection probability is rejected
A null selection probability is rejected
A zero selection probability is rejected
A selection probability above one is rejected
A deterministic decision records probability one
A decision record without policy version is rejected
Each of the five arms is a valid decision
Save quietly is a valid decision
Discard is a valid decision and is itself recorded
An arm outside the five is rejected
A non-notifying arm sends nothing to Relay
A notifying arm names the Relay request
The calibrated value probability is recorded
A decision record carries no content field
The input summary carries no content
Decision records are one_memory
Deferral to the next break carries max_defer
A non-urgent output is not interrupted now
An urgent output interrupts now
Quiet hours block an immediate non-critical interruption
A critical Grant pierces quiet hours and the budget
Critical without the user's Grant is rejected
Critical is always immediate
A muted type is never sent as a notification
A muted type goes to the digest
An exhausted budget allows no active interruption
An exhausted budget still allows passive delivery
A suggestion in its rest period is not notified
Sensitive content goes to Relay with sensitive true
Exploration needs the user's consent
Exploration between digest and next break with consent
No exploration on interrupt now
No exploration on critical outputs
A requested cloud estimate records availability
An unavailable cloud estimate has no value
An available cloud estimate records its value
Outcome signals are the written reward signals
Open, click and session time are not outcome signals
One never sends the security class
Output types are named under app.suiss.one.output
